The War Khan was a centaur khan who led his warband to attack the tauren of Mulgore during the invasion of Durotar. The centaur kidnapped several tauren, including Baine Bloodhoof, son of the tauren's high chieftain Cairne. This sent Cairne into a lethargy, and without his leadership, the centaur threatened to decimate the tauren. With the help of Bovan Windtotem and his outcasts, Rexxar and his companions found the centaur's camp, killed the War Khan, rescued Baine, and brought him back to his father, restoring Cairne's spirits.

The war in Khaz Algar was the conflict between the resurgent forces of the Void, led by Xal'atath in the absence of the now-deceased Old Gods, and the defenders of Azeroth, led by the Alliance and Horde. Following the blooming of the World Tree Amirdrassil, the Radiant Song, the voice of Azeroth herself, spread across the world and the minds of many of its inhabitants as a cry for help. This distress would manifest in a series of Radiant Echoes in which Azeroth's violent memories came to life. The cause proved to be the threat posed by Xal'atath, in possession of the Dark Heart, who traveled to Azj-Kahet to conscript the Kaheti nerubians into a new army to bring Azeroth to its knees. WarcraftPets is a database for the World of Warcraft companions and the Pet Battle System. It provides information, guides, and resources for players who want to learn about their in-game companions, including how to collect, train, and level them up. The site also features news, updates, and community discussions related to the companions. Players can also create an account and add companions to their collection to keep track of what they've already collected.

The Warband Bank, or Warbank, is an account-wide bank that consists of five 98-slot bank tabs, for a total of 490 slots. The first tab can be unlocked for , with each additional tab available at a drastically increased price. The Warband Bank is designed to be a convenient means of sharing items and gold between characters belonging to the same account. All characters on an account can access the contents from the bank. Crafting reagents can be used from the bank without having to take them out. There are two achievements, Learning to Share and So Much Sharing, earned for buying one and then the rest of the tabs. Warcraft 30th Anniversary Direct (or just Warcraft Direct) was a special presentation celebrating the 30th Anniversary of Warcraft. It was first announced at gamescom 2024 during the Opening Night Live on 20 August 2024. The event was held on 13 November 2024 at 10:00 am PST (18:00 UTC), streaming via Twitch, YouTube, and TikTok. The event included information on the Warcraft RTS games which included a 2.0 patch for and the remasters for and and updates on the other games which includes Warcraft Rumble, World of Warcraft, and . The World of Warcraft: 20 Years of Music was broadcasted after the event.

Warband Mentored Leveling is a Warband buff applied to all characters on an account that provides additional experience gains for faster leveling up to max level. It is unlocked with the One Warband Mentor: The War Within achievement, with each achievement in the series providing an additional 5% up to a total of 25% increase in experience gains through levels 1-80. The One Warband Mentor: Midnight achievement increases the max level to , with each achievement in the series providing an additional 5% up to a total of 25% increase in experience gains through levels .

WarcraftMovies was an early community hub for World of Warcraft videos, hosting machinima, PvP showcases, raid footage, and fan films during the mid‑2000s, before became the dominant video platform. It provided a centralized space for creators to upload large video files, share high‑resolution downloads, and participate in a rating‑driven community. The site is best known as the original release platform for the Leeroy Jenkins video, uploaded on 11 May 2005 by members of the guild "Pals for Life".

The war on the Coiled Isle was a brief conflict that broke out during the War of Light and Shadow as a result of Zul'jan of the Amani tribe's ill-fated attempt to secure use of the imprisoned Loa Ula'tek as a weapon against both the Twilight's Blade cult and Kingdom of Quel'Thalas under the guidance of Hex Lord Malacrass. Chieftain Zul'jarra of the Amani and a coalition of her own forces pursued Zul'jan and Malacrass to the Coiled Isle, where the vast majority of the conflict against the unleashed Children of Ula'tek now under the command of Malacrass took place.

The Warcraft II Map Editor allows users to create their own scenarios by editing the map, units, and even sound effects. Custom scenarios are called PUDs, and can be exchanged from system to system. The player is able to alter all unit stats, except for speed, including range. The mana stat is able to be increased from the default of 200 mana all the way up to a unit having 500 mana. "Hero units" count separately from their base unit of origin and can have entirely separate stats. The editor is able to place nearly all units in the game and put enemy-exclusive units under player control.

The Wardens are night elven wardens loyal to Maiev Shadowsong operating in the Broken Isles. They have worked from their base of operations, the Isle of the Watchers in Azsuna, to hunt down and neutralize major threats to Azeroth's inhabitants, through imprisonment or summary execution. Captured foes were interned in the Vault of the Wardens. They reward the heroes who help them deal with dangerous threats on the Broken Isles. The faction is known to possess Warden Towers across the Broken Isles, although in recent times they have been forced to abandon many of them. There are two in most Legion zones that serve as PvP targets.

Warcraft Story is a promotion that players can use to see interesting facts about their character. It was first introduced on 3 November 2022, leading up to the release of which used Twitter and the hashtag #WarcraftStory as part of the API to generate a image with a fact and the model of the provided player's character. It would be used again for , launching on 21 August 2024 with a website that generates a video with specific statistics for the character.

This article lists all the available pre-made Warcraft II scenarios that players can choose from when playing through multiplayer or through the custom scenario. Some of these maps were displayed on The Dark Portal, the Warcraft II official strategy guide website. These pre-made maps were likely made in-house by the Blizzard Level Design Team.

Warcraft Remastered Battle Chest is a digital compilation of all the Warcraft RTS games including the remastered and original games of and Warcraft II. It was announced and made available the same day on 13 November 2024 at the start of the Warcraft 30th Anniversary Direct. It is available for $40 USD.

Warcraft I & II Bundle was a digital compilation of the two original Warcraft RTS games, and Warcraft II: Battle.net Edition, on the platform. It was announced and made available the same day on 28 March 2019 for $15 USD. The games and the bundle are no longer available for purchase on GOG.com since 13 December 2024. Prior to the date, it had a discount code "MakeWarcraftLiveForever" that reduced the bundle's price for the remainder two weeks. Those who have purchased the games on the platform will still be able to download them indefinitely, and they'll still receive compatibility updates as part of the GOG Preservation Program.

The Warcraft Rumble EP (or the Warcraft Rumble Original Soundtrack) is the digital soundtrack for Warcraft Rumble. It was released on , and on 19 November 2024 as part of Warcraft's 30th anniversary and 1st anniversary.

Warcraft Mounts is a community website dedicated to mounts in World of Warcraft, launched in February 2008. It serves as a field guide, providing detailed information about various mounts, including their acquisition methods, appearances, and lore. The site also features news, guides, and galleries showcasing different mounts available in the game as well as various colors of a mount, even those that are not currently available to obtain. It was created by Mania who also maintained Petopia at the time before passing the torch to Wain.

Warlord Kagni was a djaradin warlord who led a Zaqali warband into launching an all-out assault against Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible in search of their missing Elder, Rashok. He was also presumably the leader of the Zaqali tribe before the awakening of the Elders. Brutal and ruthless, Kagni was willing to employ any tactic to succeed. He had a ferocious Lava Phoenix companion named Ignara. Inside Aberrus, in the Defiant Ramparts, Kagni and his djaradin troops faced off against adventurers accompanying Sabellian and Wrathion into the laboratory, in order to ensure Neltharion's secrets didn't fall into the wrong hands.
